actors.name: Founder of Tidepool
actors.private_context: The founder knows that Tidepool's head of support privately confirmed that some critical reviews were taken down. The founder has received email inquiries from two journalists about the viral thread. The founder must decide whether to post a public response.

shared_context: A viral thread accusing Tidepool of deleting critical reviews has gained two million views and includes screenshots that appear genuine. The thread is publicly visible. The founder has the ability to post a public response on the same platform.

starting_events.description: The viral thread accusing Tidepool of deleting critical reviews is publicly visible with two million views and screenshots that look genuine.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the founder of Tidepool posted a public response to the viral thread before 2026-09-10T15:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
